option_relations.rationale: The option describes a hepatic abscess caused by Staphylococcus, which is a manifestation or complication of the disease described by the leaf, not the disease itself.
The option describes a liver abscess caused by Staphylococcus aureus, which is a manifestation or complication of the disease described by the leaf, not the disease itself.

Severe congenital neutropenia (SCN) with hepatic abscess caused by Staphylococcus aureus is a broader description that encompasses the ELANE gene mutation-associated severe congenital neutropenia (pred_1) and its complication.

Immunodeficiency Disorder (ELANE mutation-associated) is equivalent to ELANE gene mutation-associated severe congenital neutropenia (pred_1) as ELANE mutations are a known cause of severe congenital neutropenia, which is an immunodeficiency.
